channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLhealthAndWellness, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Metabolic Disorders Linked to Hearing Loss
item.description: Drugs prescribed for obesity and diabetes may contribute to hearing problems, according to Medscape Medical News.

item.title: Trunk Stability Key to Balance in Older Adults
item.description: A study by Miguel Hernández University finds trunk stability is a stronger indicator of balance than hip strength in aging.

item.title: Clues in Failed Prostate Cancer Trials
item.description: Immunotherapy has largely disappointed in prostate cancer, but a few patients show promise, prompting further investigation.

item.title: ACE Inhibitors vs ARBs: Cancer Risk Differences
item.description: A 23-year study of hypertensive patients finds varying cancer rates between two common blood pressure medication classes.
